payload.text: ISSUE 0657, v2 RED AT THE JUDGE, v3 OWED (S): refs/bank/cc/0657/v2, blob 7d1f02d89685, patch-id 60b3c7c55ad9. Base: Part B's tree, scratch tip e22661b78, which is main 5d9b5e2be with the six banks applied (tree af8e2cf31dbc). The bank gives tree fdec35c0a120, in tmp/wt-cc-0657. v1 (caee73fc1d8b) is superseded on vc's two items and kept. vc verified v2 at 07:17Z by vc's clock, and under decision 100 it runs in one judge run after Part B's banks and before WP-02 v1 and ic's 0658 v3. THE RED, in that run (01M5YCYJ073KP632DV2QY6RTT0, 10:04:07Z to 10:09:06Z by vc's clock): intentsvcs does not compile. v2 adds `fn first_line(root: &Path, args: &[&str]) -> Result<Option<String>, GitRead>` to install.rs, which already has `fn first_line(text: &str) -> &str` at line 725, with callers at 688 and 710, in the base e22661b78 as on main. That is E0428, and v2's three call sites resolve to the old function (E0061, E0308, E0599). All nine errors are in install.rs, and the build stopped there. cc never built v2, since it was light work, and no light check reads a duplicate fn. V3 IS OWED over e22661b78: rename v2's helper and its three callers, and before READY grep install.rs, and each file the bank touches, for every fn the bank adds; no CHANGELOG hunk. vc verifies v3 and re-asks the same ten-patch run, and the landing patch's 0657 text is untouched by a rename. The shape, as ruled in 0657's record: source_commit.rs declares UNSHIPPED beside DIRT_SCOPE, each crate's tests/ and benches/ as two top-anchored glob exclude pathspecs, and emits both as INTENT_DIRT_SCOPE and INTENT_UNSHIPPED onto install::Build. inputs_moved and currency.lib's _build_inputs_changed hand git the same specs. PairBehindHead names the first input that moved, with the build-all remedy. The support refusal names its path. The manifest's source_commit is unchanged, and a note: line names HEAD. MODULES.md's two rows carry the clauses. The judge owes the whole crate suites with intentsvcs's, the shell half, fmt, both clippy legs, the generator check and CI's doc command. At landing vc runs `intent sync --to-store ST0056` for the guard attachment, rewords ST0087's AT-02.1, and writes the CHANGELOG line cc sent, which vc keeps in a ref for the landing commit. If a bank before it moves, cc re-banks over the new stack. No CHANGELOG hunk. No push, no release.
